name: Villafranca del Bierzo to O Cebreiro
notes: Region border: the climb is in León (El Bierzo) and O Cebreiro is in Galicia (Lugo, concello Pedrafita do Cebreiro). La Laguna de Castilla (hamlet node 349248620 at 42.70131,-7.02153, León) is 1.9 km from O Cebreiro, so the León/Lugo boundary lies in that gap and both extracts are needed. Walking order checked: Trabadelo, La Portela de Valcarce, Vega de Valcarce, Ruitelán, Las Herrerías de Valcarce, La Faba, then La Laguna de Castilla and O Cebreiro (Pereje and Ambasmestas are on the Camino too but not used). Variants (general knowledge, not mapped): the high-level Camino Duro via Pradela instead of the Valcarce valley road; the reviewer must check the corridor covers it if the app wants it. Common practice: a steep day that many guides split at Vega de Valcarce or La Faba.
